# BG Welsh LLC

> Family-owned, veteran-owned contractor in Franklin, Nebraska 68939, established 2016. Farm and ranch work is the core of the business: cattle waterers, stock water lines, trenching, feedlot runways and bunks, concrete pads, retaining walls and dirt work. BG Welsh also takes government and FEMA work: insured for FEMA work, with completed storm cleanup under a FEMA contract for a power company and site work helping build an FSA office.

- Contact: Gina Welsh, call or text (308) 470-1254
- Location: Franklin, Nebraska 68939
- Service area: about two hours of driving from Franklin, covering south-central Nebraska and northern Kansas (Kearney, Grand Island, Hastings, Lexington)
- Owners: Brian and Gina Welsh, who also run a cattle herd
- Ownership: family owned, veteran owned
- Insurance: insured for FEMA work
- NAICS: 238910 site preparation; 238110 poured concrete; 237110 water and sewer lines; 561730 landscaping; 237310 highway, street and bridge; 237990 other heavy and civil; 236220 commercial and institutional building

## For farms and ranches

- Cattle waterers set on concrete and plumbed
- Stock water lines and trenching
- Feedlot runways, aprons, alleys and bunk concrete
- Concrete pads
- Bottomless tank installation
- Retaining walls
- Dirt work: backhoe and skid steer digging, grading, cleanup, loading and gravel
- Lawn sprinkler systems

## For government buyers and contracting officers

- Storm and FEMA recovery: debris cleanup, culverts, drainage, emergency site and road repair
- Past performance: storm cleanup under a FEMA contract for a power company; site work helping build an FSA office
- Capability statement available as a web page and a PDF
